question: Where is the nearest hotel as you go southeast from North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism ILIKE '%hotel%' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%North Olmsted Recreation Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%North Olmsted%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 -- Southeast range ORDER BY ST_Distance( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%North Olmsted Recreation Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%North Olmsted%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ) :: geography, geometry :: geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Extended Stay America - Cleveland - Airport - North Olmsted
